items.title: Notification preferences
items.body_markdown: Let customers control which notifications they receive.

items.title: Customer can view and save notification preferences
items.user_story: As a customer, I want to choose which emails I receive, so that I only get relevant messages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a signed-in customer, When they save preferences, Then choices persist and appear on reload
Given an unauthenticated request, When it calls the preferences API, Then it receives 401
Given an unknown category, When saved, Then the API returns 400 ProblemDetails and the form shows the error

items.title: Add notification_preferences table migration
items.body_markdown: EF Core migration with unique (customer_id, category), FK to customers, timestamptz columns. Include rollback notes.

items.title: Enforce per-customer authorization on preferences endpoints
items.body_markdown: Authorization policy ensuring a customer can only read/write their own preferences (prevents IDOR). Add negative tests.

items.title: Spike: unsubscribe links without login (signed tokens)
items.body_markdown: Timebox 1 day. Question: can we support one-click unsubscribe with signed, expiring tokens without weakening security? Output: short ADR.
